_about: Voiceover lines for the hero video. voice.py renders a few takes of each line ('say' is the spelling the model is given, 'seeds' fixes a take); 'take' is the one used, checked with Whisper, and 'at' is when its speech begins, in seconds of the video (audio.py trims the take's lead-in and places it there). Counts are said roundly so the narration stays true as the ledger grows. 'holds' gives, for a line that speaks a number, the range of the site's count in which it still sounds right (true from the first, understated from the second); update.py flags the line outside it.

lines.text: Cyphersolver is an open ledger of historical ciphers: what was deciphered, by whom, and how.

lines.text: How far can an AI, working with a human, get on ciphers that have beaten people for centuries?
Find the letter. Transcribe every sign. Recover the key. And write it all up.
Here is one line from fifteen thirty-three.
He is to be spoken with in the morning... when he is sober.
Over five hundred entries, across six centuries.
Well over a hundred keys recovered. Every attempt is recorded, failures too, for a study with George Lasry on how AI performs.

lines.text: Helping is simple. Choose a cipher from the catalogue, or an unfinished reading from Read Further.
Paste its prompt, or just its web address, into Claude Code, and let it work.
Every contribution is credited, by name.
Pick a cipher. Break it. Write it up.
